name: Two-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Stars
statement: A finite partial cube is a star if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $C_4$ or $P_4$; both obstructions are pc-minimal.
proof: Avoiding $C_4$ forces the graph to be a tree. A tree with no convex $P_4$ has diameter at most two and is a star. Proper pc-minors of $C_4$ and $P_4$ are stars.
